thread_contract: Caller is worker0; spawn T-1; exactly T pinned physical cores; one immutable bitmap; global batches preserved.
build_contract: Serial build reported separately; whole input per insertion call, pure and hash builds in disjoint lifetimes; no parallel build claim.
status: Fresh-seed confirmation scoped to T8 and batch4096; T1/T4 remain screening-only.

eligibility.calibration: First deduplicate each same logical negative stream across T/batch, then pool the three distinct seed streams within each exact filter/allocation/n/q/insert-batch configuration. Expected 50,331,648 negatives per configuration. Seed42 is excluded.
eligibility.confidence: Two-sided95% Wilson upper from the pooled new-seed calibration; also report each seed upper bound and qualification stability.
eligibility.within_cap_selection: Consider both measured requested allocations under each actual-byte cap, for native and external independently.
eligibility.aggregate_performance: For each metric choose fixed filter/allocation configurations by the median of three seed medians. Compare the chosen native/external pair on the same seed; report all ratios and min/max.
eligibility.conservative_check: Also compare the selected native configuration against the fastest eligible external independently in each seed, retaining rival identities.
eligibility.scaling: Use direct serial lookup_ns/hash_lookup_ns from the SAME T8 row and seed, separately for pure/hash and gated/end-to-end. Do not reuse T1/4 screening timings.
eligibility.limits: Only eight physical cores, batch4096, these two data sizes, this host, and this23-configuration shortlist. No global fastest claim.
